info.title: ExpenseWise API
info.description: The API behind the ExpenseWise web and iOS apps. Money is always integer minor units plus an ISO 4217 code. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents.

bearerAuth.description: A Supabase Auth access token for a signed-in user.

assuranceLevel.description: aal2 means this session passed multi-factor authentication.

keyHint.description: The last four characters of the stored key.

authScheme.description: How the provider accepted the key: as an API key header or a bearer token.

apiKey.description: The key from the provider. It is checked with the provider, then stored encrypted and never returned.

reason.description: Why the key could not be used, when valid is false.

current.description: Whether this is the sign-in making the request.

accessToken.description: An access token for the other sign-in, from signing in with it moments ago. With the request's own token it proves the caller controls both. Used once, never stored.

token.description: Uploads one file to this path, once.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lowercase hex.

status.description: processing while it is read; extracted when both models read it with confidence and agree; needs_review otherwise; failed when no model could read it.

id.description: The receiptId from the upload ticket.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lowercase hex.

agreed.description: Of those, how many they read alike.

readingAvailable.description: Whether this server can hand receipts to the workflow runner for reading.

imageUrl.description: A short-lived link to the original file (5 minutes).

differences.description: Filing fields the two models read differently.

get.description: Returns 200 while the API can serve requests. Does not touch the database.

Connects to the database the way tenant requests do and checks what tenant isolation depends on: the runtime role, verified TLS and enforced row-level security. Results are cached for a few seconds. Details are fixed messages, never raw errors.

503.description: Not ready; at least one check failed.

post.summary: The caller's organization, created on first sign-in
post.description: Returns the organization the signed-in user belongs to. On first sign-in it creates a one-person organization with the user as owner. Safe to call on every sign-in.

get.summary: The ways the caller signs in
get.description: Every sign-in (email) that reaches the same person in this organization. Each one sees the same receipts, expenses and settings.

403.description: The caller has no organization yet: call POST /v1/me/organization first.

503.description: Sign-in or the database is not configured on this server.

post.summary: Add another sign-in for the same person
post.description: Links a second sign-in, such as a work email, to the caller. The body carries an access token for that sign-in, so the caller proves control of both. If the other sign-in had created its own organization and left it empty, it moves; otherwise nothing changes.

200.description: The sign-in was already linked to the caller.

201.description: The sign-in now reaches the caller.

403.description: The caller has no organization yet: call POST /v1/me/organization first.

409.description: The other sign-in belongs to someone else here, or has its own organization with work in it.

422.description: The token is not a valid, recent sign-in with an email address, or it is the caller.

503.description: Sign-in or the database is not configured on this server.

204.description: The sign-in no longer reaches this organization.

409.description: The sign-in making the request cannot remove itself.

post.summary: Get a one-time upload for a receipt file
post.description: Step 1 of capture (architecture 6.4). Returns a path and token the client uploads the file to directly, so image bytes never pass through the API. A file already filed in this organization is refused before it is uploaded again.

201.description: Upload the file to this path with this token, then file it.

403.description: The caller has no organization yet: call POST /v1/me/organization first.

409.description: The same file is already filed; receiptId names it.

503.description: Sign-in, the database or file storage is not configured on this server.

post.description: Step 3 of capture. Records the receipt and the event that has it read, in one transaction, then hands the event to the workflow runner. Safe to retry with the same id.
